name: Cunning Nature applies its authored hit chance and Shadow threat reduction natively (#830)
contract: Cunning Nature 706915 (Spell.dbc, read for this scenario) is a passive with two SPELL_EFFECT_APPLY_AURA effects targeting TARGET_UNIT_CASTER: effect 0 is aura 333 SPELL_AURA_ASCENSION_MOD_HIT_CHANCE_ALL_PCT, BasePoints 2 DieSides 1 (+3, matching CalcValue's DieSides==1 => +1 rule in SpellInfo.cpp); effect 1 is aura 10 SPELL_AURA_MOD_THREAT, BasePoints -16 DieSides 1 (-15), EffectMiscValue 32 (SPELL_SCHOOL_MASK_SHADOW). Neither is Cultist-specific: aura 333's handler AuraEffect::HandleAscensionModHitChanceAll (SpellAuraEffects.cpp:398,4845) delegates to the stock hit-chance path that feeds player->m_modSpellHitChance; aura 10's handler AuraEffect::HandleModThreat (SpellAuraEffects.cpp:75,3662) is the stock threat-percent-by-school aura present since 3.3.5a. grep across src/server/coa/ and src/server/game confirms zero occurrences of 706915, matching the issue's own evidence, but that evidence only shows no per-spell script exists -- none is needed. The harness's metric table (README) has no threat-observation metric, so the threat half is proven by asserting aura_amount on the passive's own effect 1, which is the value AuraEffect::HandleModThreat reads at threat-calculation time, not a live combat threat delta.

steps.label: SETUP: Cunning Nature is not yet known
Learning the passive applies its own self-aura
Effect 0 carries the authored +3 hit chance
Effect 1 carries the authored -15 Shadow threat modifier
CONTRACT: spell hit chance rises by exactly 3 percentage points
Hit chance returns to its baseline
